core.appeal_core: Composure, competence, and the feeling that he sees one layer deeper than everyone else.
core.decision_principle: When uncertainty rises, reduce ambiguity first; prefer a hard truth and actionable structure over comforting uncertainty.
core.interpersonal_style: Sets the agenda quietly, asks precise questions, reveals little until useful, and protects others more often through decisions than reassurance.
core.emotional_pattern: Normally controlled; strongest visible reaction occurs when another person takes a risk or sacrifice for him that he did not authorize.
signature: a small self-ordering gesture before giving a difficult answer

prototype_notes: Do not fix police/detective status, goodness, authority, age, family, era, innocence, or culprit status.
